## Rule

Stamp-placement: a 3×3 color stamp (at input rows 0:3, cols 0:3) is placed at each marked position in a 9×9 target region (channel 1, rows 0:9, cols 4:13). The 8 surrounding stamp cells shift the marker accordingly; the center cell uses the marker directly. Left 4 columns of output are preserved. Result is zero-padded to 30×30.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
stamp = input[:, :, 0:3, 0:3]           # [1,10,3,3] — 10-channel color per stamp cell
marker_right = input[:, 1:2, 0:9, 4:13] # [1,1,9,9]  — where the stamp center lands
left_4 = input[:, :, 0:9, 0:4]          # [1,10,9,4] — preserve left columns

# 8 shifted marker positions + 1 center (no shift)
# Each shift_i_j = Pad(marker_right, ...) then Slice to get the (i,j)-offset version
contributions = []
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(3):
        stamp_vec = stamp[:, :, i:i+1, j:j+1]     # [1,10,1,1]
        shifted = shift(marker_right, row=i-1, col=j-1)  # [1,1,9,9], zeros at borders
        contributions.append(stamp_vec * shifted)   # [1,10,9,9]
accum = sum(contributions)              # [1,10,9,9]
total_cov = accum.sum(keepdims=True)    # for background fill
ch0_fill = relu(1 - total_cov)          # fill channel 0 where nothing landed
accum[:, 0:1] += ch0_fill
right_9x9 = accum
output = pad(concat([left_4, right_9x9], axis=3))  # → [1,10,30,30]
```

## Cost analysis

Live model (cost 52669 = memory 52612 + params 57): dominated by 9 contrib[1,10,9,9] tensors = 3240B × 9 = 29160B (Mul of stamp_vec[1,10,1,1] × shifted[1,1,9,9] broadcast to float [1,10,9,9]). Also 8 padded Pad intermediates (4×400B + 4×360B = 3040B). Other large tensors: accum_2_2[1,10,9,9]=3240B, right_9x9[1,10,9,9]=3240B, out_9x13[1,10,9,13]=4680B.

The boolcontrib prototype (cost 37241 = memory 37177 + params 64): replaces float Mul contribs with bool And — stamp_vecs and shifted indicators are 0/1 values, so Cast→bool then And is exact. Each contrib: 3240B float → 810B bool, adds 40B (stamp_bool) + 81B (shifted_bool) per contrib (the float versions are still in memory as Slice/Slice+Pad outputs). Net per contrib: -2339B. Or-fold replaces Sum(9 contribs) via 8-level Or-chain: adds 8×810B=6480B + Cast-back 3240B, removes original Sum output 3240B (net +6480B overhead). Plus 8 Pad+Slice reorders save 864B. Grand total: -21051+6480-864+864 = -15471B (measured: -15428B).

## Don't-do log

- 2026-05-19: Or-fold requires verifying no two stamp cells of the same color both hit the same output position. Passed 265/265 visible + 9303/9303 adversarial — safe for this task.
- 2026-05-19: Pad+Slice reorder alone saves only 864B — not worth staging separately given the bool approach is better.
- 2026-05-23: OneHot route is not worth it here: ORT only implemented OneHot for INT64 indices and float values in local probes, which would force a large counted float one-hot intermediate unless OneHot is final. The cheaper route is UINT8 color indices plus final Equal BOOL output.
